name: Last Escort ~Shin'ya no Kokuchou Monogatari~
original_name: ラスト・エスコート 〜深夜の黒蝶物語〜
source:
The story is about our heroine Akari whose father owns a host club “Gorgeous” that she decides to start attending. Her father ironically isn’t too happy about this but she still decides to help them become top one hosts by making them sweaters, earrings hats, scarves... Will she manage to make them fall in love with her?

[based on [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/02/06/otome-game-review-last-escort-shinya-kurochou-monogatari/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]]
translation:
本作讲述女主人公明里的故事。她父亲经营着一家名为“Gorgeous”的牛郎俱乐部，而她决定开始光顾那里。讽刺的是，父亲对此并不高兴，但明里仍决心帮助店里的牛郎成为头牌，为他们制作毛衣、耳环、帽子和围巾…她最终能让这些男子爱上自己吗？

[根据[url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/02/06/otome-game-review-last-escort-shinya-kurochou-monogatari/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]整理]
